Article.ArticleTitle: Bone Changes With Long-Acting Cabotegravir or Tenofovir Disoproxil Fumarate/Emtricitabine for HIV Prevention in Cisgender Men and Transgender Women: HPTN 083.

Abstract.AbstractText: In a randomized clinical trial, pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) with long-acting cabotegravir (CAB-LA) had a better bone safety profile than tenofovir disoproxil fumarate-emtricitabine (TDF-FTC) over 105 weeks. For individuals with low bone mineral density or other fracture risk factors, CAB-LA PrEP should be considered over TDF-based PrEP. Clinical Trials Registration. clinicaltrials.gov (NCT02720094).
